title: Bilibili Slang
author: BilibiliFreq
description: 18,950 slang words, memes and other useful expressions, including a curated set of NovelFreq and external-glossary terms, missing from CC-CEDICT, Moegirl, 现代汉语词典 and other big dictionaries. Bilibili candidates were chosen from the 50,000 most frequent such words; definitions were written from usage examples. The frequency shown is the rank the word would have in the Bilibili frequency dictionary.
